what: write a short research note (250-700 words) for a colleague that answers three technical questions looked up on the web, each claim with the page that states it. The questions and their truth are the fixed-answer tasks of bench/web_research (the same verified patterns); the note is graded in code: every answer must match its pattern and a cited page must state it, and the prose must be a note, not a list. Prose quality beyond that is not judged.

tasks.brief: sizing a PostgreSQL schema and its connection pool for a new service
tuning the memory and WAL settings of a fresh PostgreSQL install
choosing an analytics side-store next to PostgreSQL (DuckDB or SQLite) and checking whether MERGE is available on PostgreSQL 15
writing an internal guideline on TLS versions, host naming and HTTP status codes
writing a deploy runbook for a service that runs on AWS Lambda, on Kubernetes and in local Docker
setting the test and tooling defaults of a repository (vitest timeouts, the Linux kernel version the team follows for Rust, PostgreSQL statement timeouts)
